test_title: PYST 26: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : CRX :: ELU : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : CRX :: ELU : % 

Option 1) # = APW, % = GNV → APW : CRX :: ELU : GNV 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2e097ab2562ad025dd6c2ed7e5e04702cf05148f64b526cead1fcc7822b534c.png] 

Option 2) # = BIY, % = HNW → BIY : CRX :: ELU : HNW 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95c915e9a5e1fc8c302de0a75b3333f4c69f222e3408a51bb22fc2c58c921899.png] 

Option 3) # = AHW, % = GMY → AHW : CRX :: ELU : GMY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bb4a313950f4f4ede5230d6f1ac3f5952e872784ce736dd49d98bb32096e0bc.png] 

Option 4) # = BPU, % = DNY → BPU : CRX :: ELU : DNY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12c2efec4350269fbdb1cf607652334c8784b0b0f4fc3b277f929b7c4ff8067f.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
